source: 792 Judgment
target: 792 Iudicium

source: Inside the slow-moving carriage, Lumian, handcuffed and shackled, stared at the window with iron bars welded and covered with thick cloth.
target: In curru lento moventi, Lumian, manubus cingulis vinctus et catenis obligatus, in fenestram aspicabat, quarum trabes ferreae coniunctae et crasso panno tectae erant.

source: His belief in his own judgment grew stronger.
target: Fides eius in proprio iudicio firmior facta est.

source: When the clergy from the Church of Knowledge accused him of being a wanted criminal, his first reaction wasn’t to be on guard but to feel a wave of confusion.
target: Cum clerici Ecclesiae Scientiae eum criminalem quaesitum accusaverunt, prima eius reactio non fuit vigilare sed undam confusionis sentire.

source: He sensed that those performing the routine exit check were there specifically for him.
target: Sensus est ei, eos qui inspectionem ordinariam exitus peragere solebant, specialiter ad eum conversos esse.

source: But apart from Ludwig and the 0-01 incident, he had no interaction with the Church of Knowledge and hadn’t harmed their interests.
target: Sed praeter Ludwigum et casum 0-01, nullam relationem cum Ecclesia Scientiae habebat neque eorum utilitates laesit.

source: Why are you Lenburgers so enthusiastic about catching an Intisian criminal?
target: Cur, o Lenburgenses, tam vehementer existitis scelestum Intisianum capere?

source: Did you even verify the details and the target’s current abilities?
target: Num diligenter perspexistis singula ac facultates praesentis rei?

source: As thoughts raced through his mind, Lumian, noticing Sallent’s surprised, fearful yet relieved gaze, thought of a possibility: Is this the hint from the Church of Knowledge?
target: Dum cogitationes per mentem eius rapiditer transibant, Lumian, Sallent oculos admiratos, timidos sed etiam solatos intuentem, contemplavit: "Num haec sit monita Ecclesiae Scientiae?"

source: No, this isn’t just a hint.
target: Non, hoc non solum est indicium.

source: They’re directly escorting me to the destination!
target: Me directe ad destinatum locum comitantur!

source: The City of Exiles, as the name suggests, is a place for exiling criminals.
target: Civitas Exilorum, ut nomen indicat, est locus ad scelestos exiliandos.

source: When I’m arrested as a wanted criminal and sentenced to exile, I’ll naturally be sent to Morora…
target: Cum, ut scelestus quaesitus, comprehensus sim et exilio damnatus, naturaliter ad Mororam mittar…

source: Isn’t this method a bit too straightforward?
target: Nonne haec methodus paulo nimis directa est?

source: How did they know I was coming?
target: Quomodo sciverunt me venturum esse?

source: Although I didn’t disguise myself, I kept a low profile the entire way…
target: Etsi me non dissimulavi, totum iter humilem tenui.

source: Are High-Sequence Beyonders of the Reader pathway adept at prophecy or divination?
target: Num Beyonders in via Lectoris Altissimae Series in vaticinatione aut divinatione periti sunt?

source: Lumian glanced at his waist, looking at the Traveler’s Bag that hadn’t been confiscated.
target: Lumian ad latus suum intueri, inspectans sacculum viatoris, quod non confiscatum erat.

source: He couldn’t help but silently grumble, “They didn’t confiscate a wanted criminal’s belongings or take measures against potential dangerous criminals to restrict the use of Beyonder powers…”
target: Silentio murmurat: “Non confiscaverunt bona scelesti quaesiti neque instituerunt cautiones contra scelestos potentialiter periculosos ad restringendum usum virium Beyonder.”

source: This performance is too unconvincing.
target: Haec repraesentatio nimis inconvincens est.

source: Are they afraid I won’t notice and might resist, causing losses?
target: An timent ut non animadvertere possim et oppugnare incipiam, damna efficiendo?

source: Lumian silently took the Traveler’s Bag from his belt and tucked it into the inner pocket of his thick jacket.
target: Lumian silentio sacculum viatoris de balte suo sustulit et in sinum internum veste crassa commisit.

source: He didn’t want to make things difficult for the clergy of the Church of Knowledge.
target: Noluit res difficile reddere pro clericis Ecclesiae Scientiae.

source: Their poor acting doesn’t matter, but I can’t be equally patronizing.
target: Agendi eorum modus miserabilis non refert; sed ego aeque indulgere non possum.

source: What if other serious offenders, nearby Azshara citizens, or assisting police officers see the Traveler’s Bag?
target: Quid si alii scelesti graviores, cives Azshara prope, vel custodes auxiliantes sacculum viatoris videant?

source: They’d think the clergy of the Church of Knowledge are unprofessional!
target: Putarent clericos Ecclesiae Scientiae esse imperitos!

source: After driving for a while, the vehicle finally stopped.
target: Post aliquod tempus, vehiculus tandem sistit.

source: Under the strict guard of several clergy members in white robes trimmed with brass, Lumian was escorted to a massive white tower.
target: Sub stricta custodia plurium clericorum, induti albis vestibus cum ornamento auri, Lumian ad magnam turrim albonem comitati est.

source: Before he could take a good look at the tower’s full appearance or even see its spire to confirm its grandeur, he was “pushed” through a side door, down a stone staircase, through a dim corridor lit by several gas wall lamps, and into a cell made of black iron.
target: Antequam plenam speciem turrim intuens aut etiam culmen eius pro magnificentia videret, per ianuam lateralem impulsum est, de scala lapidea descendens, per obscurum corridorium illuminatum pluribus lucernis gasi, et in cellam ex ferro nigro constitutam impositus est.

source: Lumian glanced around and saw about eight people already inside, all handcuffed and shackled.
target: Lumian circumspiciens vidit fere octo homines intra, omnes manubus vinctos et catenis obligatos.

source: Some were even chained through their collarbones, fixed in place.
target: Nonnulli etiam per claviculas catenati erant, firmiter in loco positi.

source: Such restraints would be effective even against Beyonders, but they couldn’t suppress those with more mystical abilities…
target: Talia vincula etiam contra Beyonderos efficacia esse poterant, sed eos cum facultatibus magis mysticis opprimere non poterant.

source: If it were me, being locked up like this would render my Hunter combat skills useless, but it wouldn’t stop me from starting fires, provoking, scouting for weaknesses, swapping fates, or teleporting to escape.
target: Si ego essem, taliter inclusus artes meas Venatoris pugnandi inutiles fuisset, sed non prohiberet me incendia accendere, provocare, infirmitates explorare, fata mutare, aut celeriter transire ad evadendum.

source: Come on, can’t you be more professional? This performance is too fake…
target: Age, non potesne esse magis peritus? Haec repraesentatio nimis ficta est…

source: Lumian thought as he watched the elder who had arrested him open the iron cell door.
target: Lumian cogitavit, spectans senex eum apprehendens ostium cellae ferrea aperire.

source: The slightly aged clergyman stepped aside and said to Lumian, “Stay here and await your judgment.”
target: Clericus paulo senescens se abdexit et Lumiano dixit: “Mane hic et iudicium tuum exspecta.”

source: Judgment? You haven’t even done the judgment yet? Have you given up on pretending?
target: Iudicium? Iudicium nondum egisti? An simulandi conatum iam reliquisti?

source: Lumian cooperatively shuffled into the cell.
target: Lumian comiter in cellam se contulit.

source: Clang! The iron cell door was closed and locked.
target: Clang! Ostium cellae ferrea clausa et reclusum erat.

source: Lumian looked around, found a metal chair fixed to the ground, and sat down, casting his gaze at the serious offenders who were sizing him up.
target: Lumian circumspiciens sedem ex metallo ad terram fixam invenit, et consedit, oculos suos in scelestos graves qui eum examinabant intendens.

source: A young man with glasses, sitting opposite him, raised his chin and said, “Didn’t expect someone younger than me to arrive. Brother, what crime did you commit?”
target: Iuvenis cum speculis, adversus eum sedens, mentum erexit et dixit: “Non exspectavi aliquem mihi iunorem adventurum esse. Frater, quid scelus commissus es?”

source: Without answering, Lumian asked in return, “What about you?”
target: Sine respondere, Lumian rogavit vicissim: “Et tu?”

source: The young man with glasses smiled and said, “Murder. Most people here are murderers.”
target: Iuvenis cum speculis subridens dixit: “Homicidium. Plerique hic homicidae sunt.”

source: “How many did you kill?” a middle-aged man with a sturdy build and chains through his collarbones asked curiously.
target: “Quot occidisti?” inquit vir medius, robusto corpore et claviculis catenatis, curiosus.

source: “Seven or eight. I’m not sure if one of them died in the end,” the young man replied with a reminiscent look.
target: “Septem vel octo. Nescio an quis eorum tandem mortuus sit,” respondit iuvenis cum aspectu reminiscente.

source: “Ending a human life with my own hands, feeling their pain, struggle, and despair, having their warm blood splatter on my face, is intoxicating.
target: Vitam hominis propriis manibus finire, dolorem, certamen atque desperationem eorum experiri, et sanguinem calidum in facie meā effundum sentire, mihi inebrians est.

source: At that moment, I felt like their god, their lord.”
target: Tunc instanti, me quasi deum eorum, dominum eorum, sentiebam.

source: A Serial Killer? Lumian silently watched, not interrupting the exchange among these serious offenders.
target: Homicida seriatim? Lumian silentio spectabat, neque sermonem inter hos scelestos graves interpellans.

source: The young man sighed in the end.
target: Iuvenis tandem suspiravit.

source: “Unfortunately, Azshara has too many detectives. They eventually found me. What about you? How many did you kill, and why?” he asked the middle-aged man with chained collarbones.
target: “Heu, Azshara nimis multas inquisitores habet. Tandem me invenerunt. Et tu? Quot occidisti, et cur?” inquit vir medius, claviculis catenatis.

source: The man replied indifferently, as if describing his breakfast, “Don’t know. Too many. Do you keep count of how many slices of bread you eat in a month?”
target: Vir indifferenter respondit, quasi de ientaculo suo narrans: “Nescio. Multa sunt. Numeras-ne quot frusta panis in mense edas?”

source: “That’s a quote from Emperor Roselle of Intis, right? I read it in a biography,” the young man replied with a smile.
target: “Ista est sententia a Imperatore Roselle de Intis, nonne? Legebam eam in biographia,” respondit iuvenis subridente.

source: “I remember eating 123 slices last month.”
target: Memini me mense priore CXLIII (123) frusta panis comedisse.

source: The middle-aged man was silent for a few seconds and then said, “I kill because they deserve to die. And the more deserving they are, the tastier their flesh.”
target: Vir medius paucis momentis tacuit deinde dixit: “Occido, quia mori debent; et quanto magis id merent, tanto sapidior caro eorum est.”

source: “You eat the people you kill?” the young man’s expression changed slightly.
target: “Edisne homines quos occidis?” inquit iuvenis, vultu leviter mutato.

source: “Depending on how much they deserve it, there are different cooking methods,” the middle-aged man replied seriously.
target: “Secundum quantum id meruerint, varia sunt modi coquendi,” respondit vir medius serio.

source: “You two are both freaks,” a sullen man in his thirties snorted.
target: “Vos duo estis vere aberrantes,” inquit vir tristis in annis tricesimis.

source: The young man didn’t get angry and asked curiously, “Why did you kill?”
target: Iuvenis, non iratus sed curiosus, rogavit: “Cur occidisti?”

source: “I didn’t kill for the sake of killing. I just wanted to rape them. Blame them on resisting too much,” the sullen man answered with a look of disdain, as if saying he was different from these perverts.
target: “Non occidi pro caede sola; volui tantum eos violare. In ipsorum nimia repugnatione culpam invenio,” respondit vir tristis vultu contemptus, quasi se ab his perversis distingueret.

source: The young man laughed and pointed to a woman with disheveled brown hair and collarbone chains, “She also rapes and kills, but that’s incidental.”
target: Iuvenis risit et ad mulierem, cui crines brunnei soluti erant et claviculae in catenis erant, demonstravit, dicens: “Illam quoque violat et occidit, sed id est incidentale.”

source: Her main purpose is collecting reproductive organs.
target: Eius praecipuum propositum est organa generativa colligere.

source: Sitting quietly on a metal chair, slightly leaning forward, Lumian couldn’t help but shake his head.
target: Sedens quiete in sella metallina, paulum inclinatus, Lumian caput concutere non potuit.

source: Does Lenburg have too many murderers? On average, each has a few body counts…
target: Num Lenburg habet nimis plures homicidas? In mediis, quisque paucos caedes numerat.

source: The gentlemanly young man looked at Lumian again.
target: Iuvenis urbanus iterum ad Lumian respexit.

source: “What about you? What major crime did you commit?”
target: “Et tu? Quod scelus grave commissus es?”

source: Lumian thought seriously for a moment and said, “Murder, blasphemy, arson, kidnapping, extortion, intimidation, deceit, causing explosions, inducing miscarriages, worshiping evil gods, attacking government officials, blackmailing the orthodox Churches…”
target: Lumian serio per momentum meditatus et dixit: “Homicidium, blasphemia, incendium, raptus, extortio, intimidatio, dolus, explosionum faciendorum, abortus inducens, deos malos colens, officiales regiminis oppugnantem, et Ecclesias orthodoxas minatione opprimens…”

source: The young man was stunned for a few seconds and then laughed.
target: Iuvenis per aliquot secundos stupefactus est deinde risit.

source: “Brother, haven’t you committed too many crimes?”
target: “Frater, num non nimis multa scelera commissus es?”

source: “Why else would I be here?” Lumian replied casually.
target: “Cur aliter hic sim?” respondit Lumian leniter.

source: “True.” The young man and the other serious offenders looked at Lumian with more respect.
target: “Vero.” Iuvenis et ceteri scelesti graves in Lumiano maiore reverentia conspexerunt.

source: “How many did you kill exactly?” the young man asked, as if he could immerse himself in the details.
target: “Quot occidisti exacte?” inquit iuvenis, quasi in minutia se immiscere posset.

source: Lumian shook his head and said in a low voice, “I didn’t count and don’t want to answer. It’s not something to boast about. It’s like a farmer culling wheat—I’m just doing my job. Would you be happy doing your daily job well?”
target: Lumian caput concussit et voce humili dixit: “Non numeravi neque vellem responsum dare; haec res non est ad gloriandum. Sicut agricola triticum selecens, officium meum tantum ago. Esne felix si cotidie officium tuum bene peragas?”

source: The young man was silent for a moment and then said, “What’s your name? I’m Guei. Maybe we’ll meet again in the land of Death.”
target: Iuvenis paululum tacuit deinde dixit: “Quod nomen tibi est? Ego sum Guei. Forsitan in terra Mortis iterum conveniamus.”

source: Lumian simply replied, “Louis.”
target: Lumian simpliciter respondit: “Louis.”

source: He didn’t want to use his real name among these people or in the City of Exiles. In mysticism, knowing someone’s real name could lead to curses.
target: Non voluit nomen suum verum apud hos aut in Urbe Exilorum uti. In mystica, nomen verum aliquis scire maledicta afferre poterat.

source: The Inevitability pathway had similar contract abilities.
target: Iter Inevitabilitatis facultates contractuales similes habebat.

source: “What about you guys?” Guei asked the others.
target: “Et vos?” inquit Guei ad ceteros.

source: “Lez,” the middle-aged man replied.
target: “Lez,” respondit vir medius.

source: The sullen man hesitated but answered, “Vijepan.”
target: Vir tristis dubitavit sed respondit: “Vijepan.”

source: “Julie,” said the woman with disheveled brown hair, her gaze lingering greedily on Guei and the others’ crotches.
target: “Julie,” inquit mulier cum capillis brunneis solutis et claviculis in catenis, oculos avide in regionem inguinalem Guei et ceterorum intendens.

source: After the serious offenders introduced themselves, Lumian smiled and said, “I didn’t expect Lenburg’s security to be so bad, with so many serial killers. Right, I’m from Intis. I haven’t been in Lenburg long.”
target: Postquam scelesti graves se invicem declaraverunt, Lumian subridet et ait: “Non exspectabam securitatem Lenburg tam pravam esse, cum tot homicidas seriatim sint. Recte, ego sum ex Intis. Non diu in Lenburg fui.”

source: Guei, the most talkative, raised his handcuffed hands, adjusted his glasses, and said with a smile, “Actually, it’s not bad, even quite good, because Lenburg has the most and best detectives in the world.”
target: Guei, qui loquacissimus erat, manus cingulis vinctas elevavit, speculas suas corrigens, et subridente dixit: “Revera, non est malum, sed etiam satis bonum, nam Lenburg maximum ac optimum numerum inspectorum in mundo habet.”

source: “But there are still many people like us—twisted personalities combined with a lot of knowledge easily create a batch of formidable criminals.
target: Sed adhuc multi sunt similes nobis—personalitates tortuosas cum magna scientia facile efficiunt coetum formidabilium scelestorum.

source: And criminals from other countries come here, wanting to challenge Lenburg’s detectives.”
target: Et scelesti ex aliis nationibus hic veniunt, volentes inspectoribus Lenburgensibus provocationem inferre.

source: Detectives are Sequence 7 of the Reader pathway, which belongs to the Church of Knowledge.
target: Inspectores sunt Series VII viae Lectoris, quae Ecclesiae Scientiae pertinent.

source: There are indeed many here…
target: Multi quidem hic adsunt…

source: Could there be real Criminals and Serial Killers among these criminals, using the Detectives for their own role‐play?
target: Num inter hos scelestos veri scelesti et homicidae seriatim esse possint, qui inspectores ad ludos suos adhibent?

source: But then again, if the detectives catch the Devil pathway criminals, they can better and faster digest their own potions…
target: Sed, si inspectores scelestos viae Diaboli prehendunt, potiones suas melius ac celerius digerre possunt.

source: Lumian thought, nodding slightly and replying with a smile, “Am I one of them?”
target: Lumian cogitavit, leviter caput adnuit et subridente dixit: “Num ego unus eorum sim?”

source: “You have a clear understanding of your own personality. The more knowledge you have, the more dangerous you become.”
target: Tuae personalitatis clarum intellectum habes. Quo plura scientiae habeas, eo periculosior fies.

source: Guei coughed and said, “Yes, I now regret not having more knowledge.”
target: Guei tussivit et dixit: “Ita, nunc paenitet me quod non plus scientiae acquisivi.”

source: As the serious offenders alternated between silence and idle chatter, time seemed to pass without notice.
target: Dum scelesti graves inter silentium et inanem sermocinando alternabant, tempus quasi inobservatum praeteribat.

source: Finally, the clergy from before escorted a woman to the cell.
target: Denique clerici pristini mulierem ad cellam duxerunt.

source: She wore a shirt with white lace flowers at the collar, a beige coat with brass trim, a dark knee-length skirt, and brown boots.
target: Ea induta erat tunica qua flores ligati albi ad collem erant, pallio beige cum ornamentis auri, lacerna obscura usque ad genua, et calceamentis fuscis.

source: Her face was oval, her light blue eyes like spring water, her nose high and straight, and her brown hair simply tied back with a bun—a very beautiful woman.
target: Facies eius ovoidis erat, oculi caerulei ut aquae vernales, nasus altus et rectus, ac crines fusci simpliciter in nodum coacti erant—mulier valde pulchra.

source: Seeing her, Vijepan’s eyes lit up.
target: Cum eam vidit, oculi Vijepan fulgore refulserunt.

source: “You have been judged, and I will announce the verdict.”
target: “Iudicatus es, et sententiam pronuntiabo.”

source: The beautiful woman said this before turning and walking toward the end of the dim corridor.
target: Inquit mulier pulchra, antequam se converteret et ad finem obscuri corridorii ambularet.

source: The other clergy opened the cell and escorted Lumian, Guei, and the others behind her.
target: Ceteri clerici cellam aperuerunt et Lumian, Guei, et ceteros post eam duxerunt.

source: They descended stone stairs, going deeper and deeper underground, until they reached a large, double brass door.
target: Descendentes scalae lapideae, semper profunda sub terra, donec ad magnam ianuam duplicem auri pervenerunt.

source: The beautiful woman with the oval face stopped and turned to face Lumian and the others, her expression serious.
target: Mulier pulchra, cuius facies ovoidis erat, sistit et ad Lumian et ceteros conversam aspicientem vultu serio constituit.

source: “Your verdict is: ‘Exile, never to return!’”
target: “Sententia vestra est: Exilium, nec umquam revertimini!”

source: “Exile to where?” Guei asked, both surprised and confused.
target: “Exilium quo?” inquit Guei, simul miratus atque confusus.

source: Not a death sentence?
target: Nonne hoc non est sententia mortis?

source: The woman pointed to the brass double doors behind her.
target: Mulier demonstravit ad ianuas duplices auri, quae post eam erant.

source: “Exile beyond these doors.”
target: “Exilium ultra has ianuas.”

source: As soon as she finished speaking, a chilling, indistinct sound came from behind the doors.
target: Statim postquam locuta est, sonus frigidus et indistinctus ex post ianuas emersit.
